meta.name: product-video-creator
meta.description: 多智能体协同的商品视频创作流水线，支持从商品信息到成视频的全流程创作：文案生成、故事策划、脚本创作、分镜设计、图片生成、字幕创作、音效推荐及视频合成；适用于电商商品宣传、品牌推广、社交媒体营销等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从商品信息自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作电商或品牌宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate promotional videos from product info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create e-commerce or brand promo videos

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,你提供商品名称、卖点、图片等信息,Claude 会走完整流程:生成文案、策划故事、编写分镜、生成镜头图片、配字幕、推荐音效,最后合成一个 MP4 视频。每一步的输出交给下一步继续处理。
howto.when: 当你给出商品名称、卖点、图片等信息,并说明视频的时长、风格、目标受众等需求时,Claude 会接管创作流程。该技能说明写明了这些触发条件。

say.text: 为这款智能手表做一支30秒宣传视频,对象是都市白领,风格偏科技感。
say.note: 启动从文案到合成的完整流水线。

say.text: 把产品图片放到文件夹,生成一支15秒短视频,风格活泼一点。
say.note: 它会按你给的图片和需求完成整支视频。

say.text: 我想给这款护肤品做视频,卖点主打紧致提亮,时长60秒。
say.note: 它会先产出文案和分镜,再合成成片。

howto.what_en: Once installed, provide product info (name, selling points, images) and video requirements; Claude runs the whole pipeline: copywriting, story, storyboard, scene images, subtitles, sound effects, then combines into an MP4. Each step's output goes to the next.
howto.when_en: When you provide product name, selling points, images, and video needs like duration, style, or target audience, Claude handles the creation flow, per the skill's stated trigger.

say_en.text: Make a 30s promo for this smartwatch, urban professionals, tech style.
say_en.note: Starts the full pipeline from copy to final video.

say_en.text: Put product photos in the folder, then make a lively 15-second short video.
say_en.note: It uses your images and needs to complete the video.

say_en.text: Make a 60s video for this skincare product, focus on firming and brightening.
say_en.note: It will draft copy and storyboard first, then render the final video.
